title: Cucumber and Tom Yum Salad
description: A refreshing salad combining the flavors of Thailand with the crunch of cucumber. This salad is light and perfect for a warm day.
instructions: 1. Peel and slice the cucumber into thin rounds.
2. In a large bowl, combine cucumber slices, Tom Yum sauce, chopped cilantro, and chopped peanuts.
3. If using, crumble the warm briny feta on top of the salad.
4. Toss gently to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
6. Serve chilled and garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
